version.description: Configuration format version read by loops.

spec_file.description: Project-relative path to the specification that drives the run.

max_cycles.description: Maximum number of autonomous engineering cycles before the run stops.

max_repair_attempts.description: Maximum repair attempts for a work unit whose verification fails.

stagnation_limit.description: Number of consecutive cycles without requirement progress before the run is blocked.

protected_paths.description: Project-relative paths restored if a coding worker modifies them.

agentConfig.description: OMP process settings shared by all model-backed workers.

command.description: Executable used to launch each OMP worker process.

model.description: Default model used by agent workers unless overridden for a specific role. If omitted, OMP chooses its default model.

thinking.description: Default OMP thinking level used unless overridden for a specific role. Values are forwarded to OMP and are not constrained by loops.

roles.description: Optional model and thinking overrides for the five model-backed worker roles.

auto_approve.description: Launches OMP with automatic tool approval so headless workers do not wait for interactive confirmation.

turn_timeout_secs.description: Maximum duration in seconds allowed for one worker invocation.

read_only_tools.description: OMP tools available to Architect, Reconcile, and Assess workers.

coding_tools.description: OMP tools available to Implement and Repair workers.

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments appended when loops launches OMP.

architect.description: Overrides for the Architect worker, which turns the specification into requirements.

reconcile.description: Overrides for the Reconcile worker, which selects the next work unit.

implement.description: Overrides for the Implement worker, which changes project files.

repair.description: Overrides for the Repair worker, which fixes failed verification.

assess.description: Overrides for the Assess worker, which evaluates implementation evidence.

model.description: Model override for this worker. If omitted, agent.model is used; if that is also omitted, OMP chooses its default.

thinking.description: Thinking-level override for this worker. If omitted, agent.thinking is used. Values are forwarded to OMP and are not constrained by loops.

verificationConfig.description: Deterministic commands and limits used to verify each implemented work unit.

auto_detect.description: Automatically detects standard project verification commands when enabled.

require_project_gate.description: Requires at least one project-specific verification command before work can pass.

commands.description: Explicit shell commands run as project verification gates.

timeout_secs.description: Maximum duration in seconds allowed for each verification command.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum number of output bytes retained from each verification command.

gitConfig.description: Repository initialization, commit, and cleanliness safeguards.

init.description: Initializes a Git repository when the project is not already inside one.

auto_commit.description: Creates loops-managed commits for accepted autonomous changes.

require_clean_tree.description: Refuses to start a run when the Git working tree already has changes.

skillsConfig.description: Additional skill directories loaded into worker environments.

shared.description: Skill directories loaded for every worker role.

roles.description: Skill directories loaded only for the named worker role.

architect.description: Additional skill directories loaded by the Architect worker.

reconcile.description: Additional skill directories loaded by the Reconcile worker.

implement.description: Additional skill directories loaded by the Implement worker.

repair.description: Additional skill directories loaded by the Repair worker.

assess.description: Additional skill directories loaded by the Assess worker.
